eligibility_constraint.reason: The frozen protocol caps fixture candidates at 100 per family. The full authored catalog exceeds this limit for LAT and DIST and remains preserved as an immutable catalog.
eligibility_constraint.rule: Only the first 100 entries of each original family sequence are eligible for execution or portable selection. This is an ordered prefix; no outcome-based reordering, replacement, or promotion of an excluded candidate is allowed. Reused completed candidates also count within this limit.

freeze_requirements: Preserve each bounded family sequence exactly: its first 100 catalog entries, including reused completed receipts. Do not dispatch or select excluded tail candidates.
Resolve both A2 prototype attempts and bind complete verified evidence; retain every valid physical rejection and investigate partial attempts without rerunning them.
Refresh the portable selection evidence references for any completed A2 prototypes.
Stage this exact input directory and reviewed source files at the intended code_root; verify all source and runtime hashes there.
Confirm both GPUs are available for the authorized scripted scene completion and retain the two-slot-per-GPU cap.
Create a separate final runtime plan with schema_version set to runtime_schema_version only after root review; hash that final plan before dispatch. No learned-policy launch is authorized.
